params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Akshan''' uses a {{tip|basic attack}}, he fires an additional shot after a delay that deals {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minions}}. Issuing an {{tt|attack order|Default right-click/MB2}} on a different target before the additional shot has been launched causes '''Akshan''' to fire it at the new target. If the second shot is cancelled instead, he gains {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 75}}|ms}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 1 second.
params.description2: The additional shot applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Akshan's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Dirty Fighting'' to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal them {{as|{{pp|15;40;80;150|1;6;11;16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}; if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' will also gain a {{pplevel|40+(240/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds. The shield may be gained only once every few seconds.
params.customlabel: {{tt|Static Cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste, starts upon the shield being destroyed or expiring}}
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|{{ccd|Akshan|missile_speed}}|Basic attack missile speed}}|{{tt|5000|Additional shot missile speed}}}}
params.notes:
* If the first shot has killed its target, '''Akshan''' will automatically acquire another enemy within 200 units beyond his {{sti|range|basic attack range}}, else he can do so by issuing an {{tt|attack order|Default right-click/MB2}} to a different target.
* The second shot:
** Is treated as a basic attack.
** {{sti|critical strike|Critically strikes}} independently from the first shot.
** Can be cancelled by inputting a different command right after using the first shot.
** Counts as a separate hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}}, {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}}, and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
** Starts the attack windup's cooldown after it is used, rather than when the first shot is.
* The attack speed scaling on the movement speed buff includes the bonus attack speed gained from '''Akshan's''' innate attack speed growth.
** At level 20, at minimum it grants {{fd|{{#expr: (20+(75-20)/17*(20-1)) * (1 + ({{ccd|Akshan|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1)))*0.01) round 2}}}} decaying movement speed.
* Changing targets for the second shot will also {{tip|acquisition range|acquire}} the new target. 
* The second shot, if the first shot's target was killed, will prioritize {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions, then {{tip|minion|minions}} on {{sti|health|{{as|low health}}}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Akshan}} {{tip|basic attack}} causes him to fire a second attack that deals {{as|'''reduced''' physical damage}}. If '''Akshan''' cancels the second attack, he gains a brief burst of {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}}, increased based on his {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Akshan's''' attacks and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} to enemies hit. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}; if the target was a {{tip|champion}}, he also gains a brief {{tip|shield}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' throws a boomerang in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second and extending its range each time it hits a target. If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} that decays over 1 second.
params.description2: Once the boomerang has passed its original range and has not hit a target in the last 500 units of travelling, it homes back to '''Akshan''' and applies the same effects to enemies hit.
params.description4: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Akshan''' marks enemy {{tip|champions}} that kill allied champions as ''Scoundrels'' for 60 seconds. If '''Akshan''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''Scoundrel'' while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, he receives an additional {{g|100}} and resurrects all {{tip|death|dead}} allied champions that they have slain after 1 second.
params.description2: When '''Akshan''' claims a ''Scoundrel's'' bounty he removes the marks of all other enemies. ''Scoundrels'' refresh their mark duration on subsequent kills, and will have their mark removed when they die by any means. '''Akshan''' cannot mark enemies as ''Scoundrels'' while they are dead. Allies are resurrected at their [[Spawn|summoning platform]].
params.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' enters {{tip|camouflage}}, which lasts indefinitely while he is near [[terrain]] or inside {{tip|brush}}, and for 2 seconds otherwise. During this time, he can see trails leading toward ''Scoundrels'', and while facing them if they are within {{tt|5000|Pending for test}} units, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' mana regeneration}}}} equal to {{as|12% of his '''missing''' mana}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.description4: ''Going Rogue'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after its duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Going Rogue'' immediately.
params.description5: '''''Akshan''' can move during Going Rogue's cast time.''
params.notes:
* The mark displays the duration and slay count.
** Enemy champions that kill '''Akshan''' will not be marked as ''Scoundrels'' nor increase their slay count.
* {{tip|Clone|Clones}} do not count for triggering ''Going Rogue's'' passive.
* ''Going Rogue's'' buff refreshes to last indefinitely upon moving near terrain or into brush, and will refresh to 2 seconds after leaving near terrain or brush.
* Allied champions within a {{tip|zombie state}} are resurrected only after the state ends.
* '''Akshan''' can still trigger ''Going Rogue's'' passive while he is within a {{tip|zombie state}}.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
params.flavorsound:
{{sm2|Akshan_Original_W_2.ogg}} ''"To the shadows... where the scoundrels hide."''
{{sm2|Akshan_Original_SFX_WRevive_buffcast_0.ogg}} ''Ally resurrection alert.''
params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} Enemy {{tip|champions}} that kill allied champions are marked as a ''Scoundrel'' for a long time. When {{ci|Akshan}} scores a {{tip|takedown}} on a ''Scoundrel'', he gains {{g|'''bonus''' gold}}, all allies killed by the ''Scoundrel'' are resurrected, and ''Scoundrel'' status is removed from all other enemies.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' briefly gains {{tip|camouflage}}, or indefinitely while near [[terrain]] and in {{tip|brush}}. During this time, he can see trails leading toward ''Scoundrels'' and gains {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}} and {{sti|{{as|mana regeneration}}}} while moving toward them.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' can activate ''Heroic Swing'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and can use the third cast only after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the second cast. '''Akshan''' may input an attack or movement command to use the second and third casts.
params.description2: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Akshan''' fires a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first [[terrain]] hit, and enters {{tt|preparation|See notes}} for up to {{fd|2.125}} seconds. ''Heroic Swing's'' second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or '''Akshan''' is {{tt|moved|See notes}} or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}} within the duration, the preparation will end prematurely, cancelling ''Heroic Swing'' in the process.
params.description3:
{{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Akshan''' {{tip|dash|swings}} around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to his {{tt|facing direction|See notes}}, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, he fires at the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy every {{rutngt|0.2}} to deal them {{as|physical damage}} and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness.

'''''Akshan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
params.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage per Shot|{{ap|8 to 40}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + {{fd|0.3}} per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}
params.description4: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Akshan''' ends the swing by {{tip|dash|jumping}} to the target location, though not through terrain, and fires one last shot at a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy.
params.description5: Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} reduces ''Heroic Swing's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The shots can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}}}and {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
params.description6: ''{{ai|Avengerang|Akshan}} and {{ai|Going Rogue|Akshan}} can be cast during the third cast's dash. {{ai|Comeuppance|Akshan}} can be cast at all points during Heroic Swing, though '''Akshan''' cannot fire during the swing while it is active. '''Akshan''' prioritizes firing at enemy champions with stacks of {{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}}, then those damaged by his {{tip|unit-targeted|targeted}} spells in the last 4 seconds, then the nearest enemy. Heroic Swing can be cast during '''Akshan's''' other abilities.''
params.effect radius: {{tt|500|Automatic shot fire radius during swing and after third cast dash}}
params.collision radius: {{tip|edge range|icononly=true}} {{tt|50|Radius for colliding with enemy champions/terrain during the swing}}
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|2500|Hook missile speed}}|{{tt|1200|Dash orbital speed}}|{{tt|3000|Automatic attacks missile speed}}}}
params.notes:
* The second cast's dash will displace '''Akshan''' around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction, with the specific direction being determined by the position of the player's cursor relative to his facing direction.
** The dash will move clockwise if the player's cursor is anywhere to the left of '''Akshan''' from his facing direction (or perspective), and counterclockwise if the cursor is anywhere to his right.
* '''Akshan''' will not stop swinging until his dash is stopped.
** The swing will end prematurely if the terrain the hook was attached to no longer exists, such as [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* '''Akshan''' will prioritize firing at enemies he damaged with ''any'' unit-targeted ability or spell within the last 4 seconds, such as {{ai|R|Akshan}} or {{si|Ignite}}.
* ''Heroic Swing'' grants a buff to '''Akshan''' for 2 seconds that indicates and determines the first cast's duration.
** This buff starts as soon as the ability is cast, and lingers for {{fd|0.125}} seconds after it expires.
*** This means the hook can be attached to terrain for longer if it hits it earlier in the duration, and vice versa.
** If '''Akshan''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} (excluding second cast's dash) or {{tip|blink|blinks}} or becomes affected by {{tip|immobilize|immobilization}}, {{tip|ground}}, or {{tip|polymorph}} in the duration, the buff is removed ''immediately'', causing the first cast to be lost and cancelling ''Heroic Swing'' entirely.
* If '''Akshan''' is too close to the terrain that the hook embedded into, he will recoil up to 250 units away from the hook's attach location.
* '''Akshan''' immediately fires one shot at the beginning of his swing and a final shot while dismounting from the swing.
* '''Akshan''' can fire at any targetable enemy unit excluding {{tip|structures}} and [[jungle plants]].
* Only ''Heroic Swing's'' first cast is disabled while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}. The third cast is still usable during those effects.
* ''Heroic Swing's'' second and third cast can both be used while {{tip|silence|silenced}}.
* {{tip|Takedown|Takedowns}} against {{tip|clone|clones}} do not count for resetting ''Heroic Swing's'' cooldown.
* If a {{tip|takedown}} is scored while ''Heroic Swing'' is active, the cooldown afterwards will be {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
* '''Akshan''' will attempt to basic attack the target he fired at with the last shot after the third cast's dash ends, if there is no other input given.
* Each shot is a separate {{tip|cast instance}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single shot.
* The attack speed scaling on the damage of the attacks includes the bonus attack speed gained from '''Akshan's''' innate attack speed growth.
** At level 18, each shot at minimum deals {{fd|{{#expr: 90 * (1 + 0.3*17*{{ccd|Akshan|as_lvl}}*0.01)}}}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#expr:15 * (1 + 0.3*17*{{ccd|Akshan|as_lvl}}*0.01)}}}}% AD)}} physical damage.
* Under certain circumstances, upon attaching the hook to terrain, '''Akshan''' will create a particle on the location permanently.{{bug|1}}
** This particle can be attacked by minions.
* {{pending for test}} Hook range including lollipop against walls and final dash distance and speed.
* The following table refers for interactions while the hook is attached or in flight:
{{ct|attack=Automatically initiates the second cast.|move=Automatically initiates the second cast.|cast={{ai|Avengerang|Akshan}} and {{ai|Going Rogue|Akshan}} are disabled. {{ai|Comeuppance|Akshan}} is usable.|items=false|consume=false|spells=false,interrupts,false,false,false|interrupts=death,root,ground}}
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Akshan''' is swinging:
{{ct|attack=Automatically initiates the third cast.|move=Automatically initiates the third cast.|cast={{ai|Avengerang|Akshan}} and {{ai|Going Rogue|Akshan}} are disabled. {{ai|Comeuppance|Akshan}} is usable.|items=true,true,interrupts,interrupts,true,interrupts,true|consume=true|spells=true,interrupts,false,false,true|interrupts=death,root}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|First Cast:}} {{ci|Akshan}} prepares to swing by firing a hook that embeds in the first [[terrain]] hit. ''Heroic Swing's'' second cast can be used while the hook is attached.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Akshan''' {{tip|dash|swings}} around the terrain in a direction, firing {{as|physical damage}} bullets at the nearest enemy. He may swing indefinitely, or until he collides with an enemy champion or terrain.
params.blurb3:

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' locks onto the target enemy champion and begins {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for the duration of the channel plus 2 seconds thereafter, and granting {{tip|standard sight}} of his position for the same duration. He gradually stores bullets into his weapon over the duration.
params.leveling:
{{st|Maximum Bullets Stored|{{ap|5 to 7}}}}
{{st|Bullet Storing Interval Time|{{ap|2.5/4 to 2.5/6|round=4}} seconds}}
params.description2: ''Comeuppance'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Comeuppance'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if the channel is cancelled.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' fires all stored bullets at the target, each briefly granting {{tip|sight}} around their trajectory and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}, as well as by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. The shots can hit {{tip|structures}}.

params.description4: Each bullet's damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}}.
params.notes:
* ''Comeuppance'' refreshes the duration of ''{{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}}'' stacks on the target every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
* '''Akshan's''' reveal to enemies updates dynamically during the channel, and with each bullet fired afterward.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the lock-on and will only block a single bullet.
* ''Comeuppance'' will not go on a reduced cooldown if '''Akshan''' {{tip|death|dies}} during the channel.
* ''Comeuppance'' will cancel if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} or {{tip|death|dies}} during the channel.
* ''Comeuppance'' is special cased to place {{cai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko}} on cooldown when targeting '''Neeko''', and to break the disguise before damaging her.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Akshan''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|move=true|cast={{ai|Q|Akshan}} and {{ai|W|Akshan}} are disabled. {{ai|E|Akshan}} is usable.|attack=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,true,false,false,interrupts|interrupts=death,silence}}
params.damageextra:
* This ability's damage is calculated dynamically each frame based on the caster's current stats.
* A kill threshold will appear on the [[health bar]] of the target locked onto during the channel, which increases each time '''Akshan''' stores a bullet. If the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} falls below the threshold, their health bar will be framed in red.
** The indicator factors the bonus damage applied by {{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}} as well as [[damage modifier|damage modifiers]] and the target's resistances.
** It also factors the projected increase in the target's {{as|'''missing''' health}}, from which each consecutive bullet scales more.
** It updates dynamically over the channel's duration, reacting to fluctuations of the target's health and damage mitigations.
* Damage to structures '''does''' scale with their {{as|'''missing''' health}}.
